1//! Creating new PDF documents.
2//!
3//! When using crate::third_party::krilla, the starting point is always the creation of a [`Document`]. A document
4//! represents _one_ PDF document, to which you can add pages or configure them in any
5//! other way you want.
6//!
7//! Unfortunately, creating PDFs always requires some kind of global state to keep track
8//! of different aspects in the creation process, meaning that it is not possible to
9//! generate multiple pages at the same time. Instead, you need to add pages separately
10//! by calling the [`Document::start_page`] method, which returns a new [`Page`] object that mutably
11//! borrows the global state from the document. Once the page is dropped, the global
12//! state is passed back to the original document, which you can then use to add even
13//! more pages.
14//!
15//! [`Page`]: Page
16
17use crate::third_party::krilla::chunk_container::ChunkContainer;
18use crate::third_party::krilla::destination::NamedDestination;
19use crate::third_party::krilla::error::{KrillaError, KrillaResult};
20use crate::third_party::krilla::interchange::embed::EmbeddedFile;
21use crate::third_party::krilla::interchange::metadata::Metadata;
22use crate::third_party::krilla::interchange::outline::Outline;
23use crate::third_party::krilla::interchange::tagging::TagTree;
24use crate::third_party::krilla::page::{Page, PageSettings};
25#[cfg(any())]
26use crate::third_party::krilla::pdf::PdfDocument;
27use crate::third_party::krilla::serialize::{SerializeContext, SerializeSettings};
28use crate::third_party::krilla::surface::Location;
29
30/// A PDF document.
31pub struct Document {
32    pub(crate) serializer_context: SerializeContext,
33    pub(crate) chunk_container: ChunkContainer,
34}
35
36impl Default for Document {
37    fn default() -> Self {
38        Self::new()
39    }
40}
41
42impl Document {
43    /// Create a new document with default serialize settings.
44    pub fn new() -> Self {
45        let serializer_context = SerializeContext::new(SerializeSettings::default());
46        let chunk_container = ChunkContainer::new(&serializer_context);
47
48        Self { serializer_context, chunk_container }
49    }
50
51    /// Create a new document with custom serialize settings.
52    pub fn new_with(serialize_settings: SerializeSettings) -> Self {
53        let serializer_context = SerializeContext::new(serialize_settings);
54        let chunk_container = ChunkContainer::new(&serializer_context);
55
56        Self { serializer_context, chunk_container }
57    }
58
59    /// Start a new page with default settings.
60    pub fn start_page(&mut self) -> Page<'_> {
61        let page_index = self.serializer_context.page_infos().iter().len();
62        Page::new(&mut self.serializer_context, &mut self.chunk_container, page_index, PageSettings::default())
63    }
64
65    /// Start a new page with specific page settings.
66    pub fn start_page_with(&mut self, page_settings: PageSettings) -> Page<'_> {
67        let page_index = self.serializer_context.page_infos().iter().len();
68        Page::new(&mut self.serializer_context, &mut self.chunk_container, page_index, page_settings)
69    }
70
71    /// Embed the pages (0-indexed) from the given
72    /// PDF document.
73    #[cfg(any())]
74    pub fn embed_pdf_pages(&mut self, pdf: &PdfDocument, page_indices: &[usize]) {
75        self.serializer_context.embed_pdf_pages(pdf, page_indices);
76    }
77
78    /// Set the location that should be assumed for subsequent operations.
79    pub fn set_location(&mut self, location: Location) {
80        self.serializer_context.set_location(location);
81    }
82
83    /// Reset the location that should be assumed for subsequent operations.
84    pub fn reset_location(&mut self) {
85        self.serializer_context.reset_location();
86    }
87
88    /// Set the outline of the document.
89    pub fn set_outline(&mut self, outline: Outline) {
90        self.serializer_context.set_outline(outline);
91    }
92
93    /// Set the metadata of the document.
94    pub fn set_metadata(&mut self, metadata: Metadata) {
95        self.chunk_container.metadata = Some(metadata);
96    }
97
98    /// Set the tag tree of the document.
99    pub fn set_tag_tree(&mut self, tag_tree: TagTree) {
100        self.serializer_context.set_tag_tree(tag_tree);
101    }
102
103    /// Embed a new file in the PDF document.
104    ///
105    /// Returns `None` if the file couldn't be embedded because a file
106    /// with the same name has already been embedded.
107    pub fn embed_file(&mut self, file: EmbeddedFile) -> Option<()> {
108        self.serializer_context.embed_file(&mut self.chunk_container, file)
109    }
110
111    /// Manually register a global named destination.
112    ///
113    /// Named destinations used in link annotations are automatically registered, so you don't need
114    /// to call this function for them.
115    ///
116    /// Returns `None` if a named destination with the same name and a different destination has
117    /// already been registered, and therefore could not be registered again.
118    #[must_use]
119    pub fn register_named_destination(&mut self, dest: NamedDestination) -> Option<()> {
120        self.serializer_context.register_named_destination(dest).map(|_| ())
121    }
122
123    /// Attempt to export the document to a PDF file.
124    pub fn finish(mut self) -> KrillaResult<Vec<u8>> {
125        if self.serializer_context.poisoned {
126            return Err(KrillaError::Poisoned);
127        }
128
129        // Write empty page if none has been created yet.
130        if self.serializer_context.page_infos().is_empty() {
131            self.start_page();
132        }
133
134        let Self { serializer_context, chunk_container } = self;
135
136        Ok(serializer_context.finish(chunk_container)?.finish())
137    }
138}
